title: Paper Boat: New and Selected Poems 1961-2023

vibeProfile.oneLine: Sixty years of Atwood's poetry, from sharp beginnings to late grief.

summary: Six decades of Margaret Atwood's poetry in one generous volume, from her earliest sharp-edged work to recent poems on aging, grief and the natural world. Long celebrated as a novelist, Atwood began as a poet, and these pages show the same wit, mythic imagination and cool precision at work in verse. Spanning 1961 to 2023, it is both a career retrospective and a reminder that one of the great living writers has always been, first, a poet.
whyReadIt: Six decades of Atwood the poet, where a lot of readers forget she began. Witty, mythic and cool-eyed.

funFacts.text: Atwood published poetry before fiction, and has always considered herself a poet first.
